title: Clinical Outcomes of Root Canal Treatment Using Modern Irrigation Protocols
official: Clinical Outcomes of Root Canal Treatment Using Modern Irrigation Protocols
summary: Post-operative pain remains a frequent complication after root canal treatments. This clinical trial evaluates the post-operative outcome following endodontic treatments using four irrigation approaches: conventional needle irrigation, GentleWave®, EdgePRO™, and Fotona LightWalker®. The study will assess patients' post-operative pain and other symptoms following treatment, as well as healing of the tissues around the treated tooth over time.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults older than 18 years of age who need root canal treatment.

Exclusion Criteria:

* The intake of analgesics within the previous 8h, substance abuse, additional pulpal pathology on the same side, systemic conditions classified as ASA III or higher.
* Adults unable to consent, minors less than 18 years of age, pregnant women, and prisoners
